Part I — Knowledge Base (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 62, English)
The Science of Mantra, Part 2: How Mantra Moves Through the Fifth to Eighth Dimensions

Sour ce: A solo teaching video, continuing dir ectly from a prior "Science of Mantra" video (Part 1). This document is Part I of II — Knowledge Base and Q&A Pairs. Note: this session is a solo training video with no live sangat interaction, so ther e is no Part III (Curated Conversational Q&A) for this session.

1. This session is Part 2 of "Science of Mantra." Bhaiya explicitly states this video continues a discussion begun in a prior video (Part 1) and recommends watching that first video before this one, since this session builds directly on concepts already introduced there (particularly the 4th Dimension/time discussion).

2. Mantra operates thr ough the astral body , not the physical body . Per this teaching, everything described in this session concerns how mantra functions and takes ef fect within the astral (sookshma) body — not the physical body .

3. Why mantra exists at all — the rishi-munis' original insight. Per this teaching, ancient rishi-munis (sages) understood that the physical human body cannot cross certain Dimensions on its own. So they devised mantra as an "agent" — something that could be sent ahead to cross Dimensions the physical body cannot, and accomplish there what the human body itself cannot directly do. Bhaiya frames this as a mark of the sages' genius, and notes that Ashaeiynn's own explanation of this mechanism (via devta shaktis, per his Gurudev's guidance) is built on understanding that same original insight.
4. Fourth Dimension r ecap: mantra and time. Per this teaching (recapping the prior video), the 4th Dimension is time. Within the 4th Dimension, mantra can move forward and backward in time.

5. Fifth Dimension: mantra can move both in time and "up-down," enabling bilocation of the astral body . Per this teaching, when mantra reaches the 5th Dimension, it can move forward/backward in time and up/down simultaneously . This means the astral body of the practitioner can exist and function at two dif ferent places at the exact same point in time.

6. Illustrative example: a saint whose subtle body is always in meditation. Per this teaching, this is why it is often observed that a great saint's astral body always appears to be in a meditative posture (dhyan mudra) even while, in another location, the same saint is visibly engaged in an entirely dif ferent task (e.g., physically active work, or driving out negative ener gy from someone) — this dual, simultaneous presence is possible specifically because that person's mantra has reached the 5th Dimension.

7. Sixth Dimension: mantra enables pr esence at countless places simultaneously . Per this teaching, at the 6th Dimension, a person's astral body is no longer limited to two locations — it can be present at innumerable ("anginat") places at the very same instant.

8. Illustrative example: a diya offer ed "with Bhaiya as witness." Per this teaching, when any Ashaeiynn member of fers a diya to Hanuman Ji Maharaj while mentally taking Bhaiya as witness (sakshi), Bhaiya's own astral body is instantly present at that moment to ensure the of fering genuinely reaches Hanuman Ji Maharaj's feet. If 100 dif ferent members, in 100 dif ferent locations, do this at the same time, that same astral body can be simultaneously present, in 100 forms, at all 100 locations at once — described as a clear illustration of 6th-Dimension capability , and consistent with how many saints are historically described as being present at multiple locations at the same time.

9. Scientific parallel offer ed for these Dimension claims. Per this teaching, Bhaiya references String Theory (attributed to Michio Kaku, with Richard Feynman noted as having further advanced related ideas) and M-Theory as scientific frameworks that similarly describe multiple Dimensions in ways that parallel what is being taught here — of fered as a rebuttal to the idea that these teachings are simply invented ("agar hum manghadant baat bol rahe hain to phir wo bhi manghadant bol rahe hain").

10. These claims ar e framed as experiential, not mer ely theor etical. Per this teaching, Ashaeiynn members are expected to personally experience these Dimension-related phenomena over time as part of ongoing practice, rather than simply accept them as abstract claims.

1 1. Seventh Dimension: mantra enables travel to parallel worlds/other lokas. Per this teaching, at the 7th Dimension, in scientific terms this corresponds to what is called the "parallel universe" or "parallel world." Through subtle sight (sookshma drishti), a practitioner whose mantra has reached this Dimension can travel with their astral body to numerous lokas and have darshan (vision) of numerous deities — while physically remaining in one place.

12. Which lokas become accessible at the 7th Dimension. Per this teaching, examples given include Surya Lok (Sun realm), Chandra Lok (Moon realm), Mangal Lok (Mars realm), Vaikunth Lok, Hanuman Ji Maharaj's own lok, and Kailash — but only once a person's mantra has actually reached the 7th Dimension; it is not otherwise possible.

13. Saints who grant darshan of various lokas necessarily have 7th-Dimension mantra. Per this teaching, any saint historically described as being able to grant others visions/darshan of dif ferent lokas is, by this framework, someone whose mantra has necessarily reached the 7th Dimension.

14. Eighth Dimension: "no-matter existence" — becoming omnipr esent (sarvatra). Per this teaching, at the 8th Dimension, in scientific terms this is described as a "no matter existence." In subtle-sight terms, the practitioner becomes sarvatra — uniformly present everywhere at once.

15. Illustrative cultural r eference: the film "Lucy ." Per this teaching, Bhaiya draws a comparison to the Hollywood film Lucy (starring Scarlett Johansson), in which the lead character , upon reaching 100% brain capacity , is depicted as losing a fixed physical existence and becoming present everywhere at once — of fered as an illustrative (not literal) parallel to what happens at the 8th Dimension.

16. What "sarvatra" means practically , per this teaching. Per this teaching, once a person's mantra reaches the 8th Dimension, whenever and wherever in the universe that person's name is invoked, the response/presence is described as becoming uniform and equal everywhere at once — it is no longer tied to one specific location.

17. Higher Dimensions exist beyond the 8th, taught pr ogr essively . Per this teaching, Dimensions continue to increase beyond the 8th (9th, 10th, and so on), each conferring further powers, described as an ongoing, progressive unfolding rather than a fixed endpoint.

18. Bhaiya's own stated dir ect experience is limited to the 12th–13th Dimension. Per this teaching, Bhaiya states that he and his Gurudev have personally seen up to the 12th–13th Dimension themselves; anything beyond that has not been shown to him by his own Gurudev , and he does not claim knowledge beyond that point.

19. Deeper Dimension teachings ar e given only to those who become capable of r eceiving them. Per this teaching, knowledge of the higher Dimensions (9th, 10th, and beyond) is shared only with practitioners who become worthy and who develop suf ficient grahan shakti (capacity to receive/absorb) to understand and hold that knowledge responsibly .

20. The overall purpose of this teaching. Per this teaching, the intent of walking through how mantra operates via the astral/subtle body across Dimensions is to help practitioners implement these stages progressively in their own spiritual life, working toward attaining the "parama tatva" (the supreme/ultimate element) — described as the ultimate goal of every human being.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

Mantra operates through the astral (sookshma) body , not the physical body — it functions as an "agent" the physical body sends ahead to cross Dimensions it cannot cross on its own. 4th Dimension = time: mantra can move forward/backward in time. 5th Dimension: mantra can move in time and "up-down" simultaneously , allowing a practitioner's astral body to exist at two locations at the same instant (e.g., a saint's subtle body remaining in meditation while another is active elsewhere). 6th Dimension: mantra enables presence at countless locations simultaneously (e.g., Bhaiya's astral body attending every diya of fered "with Bhaiya as witness," across any number of simultaneous of ferings). 7th Dimension: corresponds to the "parallel universe/world" concept — enables subtle-body travel to and darshan of various lokas (Surya Lok, Chandra Lok, Mangal Lok, Vaikunth Lok, Hanuman Ji's lok, Kailash). 8th Dimension: a "no-matter existence" — the practitioner becomes sarvatra (uniformly present everywhere at once), illustrated (not literally) via the film "Lucy ." Dimensions continue to increase beyond the 8th; Bhaiya and his Gurudev have personally seen up to the 12th–13th Dimension themselves, and knowledge beyond that point has not been shown to him. Higher -Dimension knowledge is shared only with practitioners who become capable (in grahan shakti) of receiving and holding it responsibly . This session is a solo teaching video with no live sangat interaction — there is no Part III (Curated Conversational Q&A) for this session, only Parts I and II. Part II — Q&A Pairs (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 62, English)
The Science of Mantra, Part 2: How Mantra Moves Through the Fifth to Eighth Dimensions

User-style questions with answers gr ounded in this Ashaeiynn training session. Gr eeting style: "Jai Siyaram." Note: this session is a solo training video with no live sangat interaction, so ther e is no Part III (Curated Conversational Q&A) for this session — only Parts I and II.

Q1. What is this session's topic, and how does it r elate to a prior video? A: Per this teaching, this session is Part 2 of "Science of Mantra," directly continuing a discussion begun in a prior video (Part 1), which viewers are advised to watch first.
Q2. Does mantra work thr ough the physical body or the astral body? A: Per this teaching, mantra operates and takes ef fect entirely through the astral (sookshma) body , not the physical body .

Q3. Why did the ancient rishi-munis cr eate mantras in the first place, per this teaching? A: Per this teaching, because the physical human body cannot cross certain Dimensions on its own, the rishi-munis devised mantra as an "agent" that could be sent ahead to cross those Dimensions and accomplish what the physical body itself cannot do directly .
Q4. What is the 4th Dimension, per this teaching? A: Per this teaching, the 4th Dimension is time — within it, mantra can move forward and backward in time (a concept covered in the prior video).

Q5. What new capability does mantra gain at the 5th Dimension? A: Per this teaching, at the 5th Dimension, mantra can move both forward/backward in time and "up and down" simultaneously , enabling a practitioner's astral body to exist and function at two dif ferent locations at the same instant.

Q6. Can you give an example of 5th-Dimension capability in action? A: Per this teaching, a great saint's astral body may always appear to be in meditative posture in one place, while the same saint is visibly engaged in a completely dif ferent task (such as physically active work) elsewhere at the same time — made possible because their mantra has reached the 5th Dimension.
Q7. What happens at the 6th Dimension? A: Per this teaching, at the 6th Dimension, a person's astral body can be present at innumerable locations simultaneously , not just two.

Q8. What example illustrates 6th-Dimension capability , per this teaching? A: Per this teaching, when any Ashaeiynn member of fers a diya to Hanuman Ji Maharaj taking Bhaiya as witness, Bhaiya's astral body is instantly present to ensure the of fering reaches Hanuman Ji Maharaj — and if 100 members do this simultaneously from 100 dif ferent locations, that same astral body can be present, in 100 forms, at all 100 locations at once.

Q9. Does this teaching claim any scientific backing for the Dimension concept? A: Per this teaching, yes — Bhaiya references String Theory (attributed to Michio Kaku, with Richard Feynman noted as having advanced related ideas) and M-Theory as scientific frameworks that similarly describe multiple Dimensions, of fered as a response to the idea that these teachings are simply invented.

Q10. Are practitioners expected to just believe these Dimension claims, or something mor e? A: Per this teaching, Ashaeiynn members are expected to personally experience these Dimension-related phenomena over time through ongoing practice, not simply
accept them as abstract claims.

Q1 1. What does the 7th Dimension enable, per this teaching? A: Per this teaching, the 7th Dimension corresponds scientifically to the "parallel universe/parallel world" concept — a practitioner whose mantra has reached this Dimension can travel with their astral body to various lokas and have darshan of various deities while physically remaining in one place.

Q12. Which lokas become accessible once mantra r eaches the 7th Dimension? A: Per this teaching, examples given include Surya Lok, Chandra Lok, Mangal Lok, Vaikunth Lok, Hanuman Ji Maharaj's own lok, and Kailash.

Q13. What does it mean if a saint is described as able to grant others darshan of various lokas? A: Per this teaching, such a saint necessarily has mantra that has reached the 7th Dimension, since this capability is specifically tied to that Dimension.

Q14. What happens at the 8th Dimension? A: Per this teaching, at the 8th Dimension — described scientifically as a "no-matter existence" — the practitioner becomes sarvatra, meaning uniformly present everywhere at once.

Q15. Is ther e a pop-cultur e illustration Bhaiya uses for the 8th Dimension? A: Per this teaching, yes — he references the Hollywood film "Lucy" (starring Scarlett Johansson), in which the lead character , upon reaching 100% brain capacity , is depicted losing a fixed physical existence and becoming present everywhere — of fered as an illustrative, not literal, parallel.

Q16. What does it mean, practically , for a person's mantra to become "sarvatra" at the 8th Dimension? A: Per this teaching, wherever and whenever in the universe that person's name is invoked, the resulting presence/response becomes uniform and equal everywhere at once, no longer tied to a single fixed location.

Q17. Do Dimensions stop incr easing after the 8th? A: No — per this teaching, Dimensions continue to increase beyond the 8th (9th, 10th, and further), each conferring additional powers, as an ongoing progressive unfolding.

Q18. How far has Bhaiya himself dir ectly experienced these Dimensions? A: Per this teaching, Bhaiya states that he and his Gurudev have personally seen up to the 12th–13th Dimension themselves; anything beyond that has not been shown to him, and he makes no claims beyond that point.

Q19. Is knowledge of the higher Dimensions shar ed with everyone equally? A: No — per this teaching, deeper knowledge of the higher Dimensions (9th, 10th, and beyond) is shared only with practitioners who become worthy and who develop suf ficient grahan shakti (capacity to receive/absorb) to hold that knowledge responsibly .

Q20. What is the overall purpose behind teaching how mantra moves thr ough these Dimensions? A: Per this teaching, the purpose is to help practitioners progressively implement these stages in their own spiritual life and work toward attaining the "parama tatva" (supreme/ultimate element) — described as the ultimate goal of every human being.

Keep the "diya with Bhaiya as witness" example intact as this teaching's own specific illustration of the 6th Dimension, without generalizing it into a claim about all spiritual teachers. Maintain the point that higher -Dimension knowledge is shared progressively and only with those who become capable of receiving it — do not present this as gatekeeping without explaining the stated rationale (capacity/grahan shakti).
